papers.title: M-LINKX: Multiview Graph Learning for Brain Cognitive Disease Detection
papers.reason: The study centrally analyses frequency-band-specific EEG functional connectivity graphs for classifying human participants with MCI and dementia, but includes no interactive task, eye tracking, or cognitive process model.

papers.title: Effects of Rhodiola rosea Combined With Auricular Vagus Nerve Electrical Stimulation on Gut Microbiota and Cognitive Function in Patients With Cognitive Impairment of Qi Deficiency and Blood Stasis Type
papers.reason: This human clinical treatment study monitors cognition with MoCA and MMSE but contains no interactive decision task, eye tracking, qualifying EEG analysis, or computational model of cognition.
